children: Liquidia said a Delaware court ruled two claims of U.S. Patent No. 11,826,327 are valid and infringed as to YUTREPIA.
District Court ruled claims 1 and 14 of the ’327 patent are valid and infringed by YUTREPIA; other asserted claims invalid.
Parties ordered to submit proposed form of judgment specifying remedies within one week.
Potential remedies may include removal of the PH-ILD indication or broader restrictions on product availability.
Liquidia plans to pursue all appellate options and intends to submit an FDA supplement to remove PH-ILD from the label.
Company says it cannot reasonably estimate outcomes or financial exposure given possible appeals and further proceedings.
